name: NE-501 Multi Pump Controller
description_zh: 本實驗室開發的 Windows 桌面控制程式，供 New Era NE-501 OEM 針筒幫浦四通道 RS-232 操作與教學使用。
description_en: Lab-developed Windows desktop software for teaching and research with four New Era NE-501 OEM syringe pumps over RS-232.
features_zh: 四台獨立控制、針筒內徑驗證、Prime 五段速度、流量與方向設定、群組 RUN／STOP、模擬模式及 CSV 通訊紀錄。
features_en: Four independent pump panels, syringe diameter read-back, five Prime presets, flow and direction settings, grouped run/stop, simulation mode and CSV command logs.
requirements_zh: 此公開檔為原始碼及中英文文字說明 ZIP，不含 Windows .exe 或圖文版 DOCX／PDF。需在 Windows 安裝 Python、PySide6、pyserial 和 USB-RS-232 驅動；可依內附腳本執行與建置。原始碼未附通用開源授權。
requirements_en: This compact ZIP contains source and bilingual text documentation, not a compiled EXE or image-rich DOCX/PDF manuals. Requires Windows, Python, PySide6, pyserial and a USB-RS-232 driver. No general open-source license is declared.
safety_zh: 注意：程式的 Emergency Stop 依賴電腦與序列通訊，不能取代硬體急停；Prime 速度預設不等於壓力保護。本公開打包版本尚未重新進行實機驗證，請先以模擬模式及安全管路檢查。
safety_en: Safety: software emergency stop depends on PC/serial communications; it does not replace a physical E-stop. Prime presets are not pressure limits. This public source archive has not been revalidated on real hardware.
